---
title: "Player Scouting Explorer"
---

Use the interactive filters below to scout **2,920 players** across Europe's Top Five leagues in 2021–2022. Try narrowing the **Age** slider to `16–22` to find U-22 breakout stars, selecting a specific **Club** or **League**, or sorting the table below by **G+A**, **SCA/90** (Shot-Creating Actions), **Prog Pass/90**, or **Tkl+Int/90** (Tackles + Interceptions) to compare two-way midfielders, attacking fullbacks, and clinical strikers.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

# Select only the scouting columns needed so the static HTML page loads fast
scouting_df <- read_delim(
  "2021-2022 Football Player Stats.csv",
  delim = ";",
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(!is.na(Age), !is.na(Min)) |>
  mutate(
    Position = factor(
      str_sub(Pos, 1, 2),
      levels = c("FW", "MF", "DF", "GK"),
      labels = c("Forward", "Midfielder", "Defender", "Goalkeeper")
    ),
    Goals_Tot = round(Goals * `90s`),
    Assists_Tot = round(Assists * `90s`),
    GA_Tot = Goals_Tot + Assists_Tot,
    GA_per_90 = round(Goals + Assists, 2),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>", Player, "</b> (", Squad, " — ", Comp, ")<br>",
      "Position: ", Pos, " | Age: ", Age, " | Min: ", scales::comma(Min), "<br>",
      "Season Totals: <b>", GA_Tot, " G+A</b> (", Goals_Tot, "G, ", Assists_Tot, "A)<br>",
      "Per 90: ", GA_per_90, " G+A | ", SCA, " SCA | ", `Tkl+Int`, " Tkl+Int"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    Player,
    Squad,
    Comp,
    Position,
    Age,
    Min,
    Goals_Tot,
    Assists_Tot,
    GA_Tot,
    GA_per_90,
    SCA,
    PasProg,
    CarProg,
    `Tkl+Int`,
    hover_text
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(GA_Tot), desc(Min))

# SharedData links the filter controls to both the Plotly chart and the DT table
shared_players <- SharedData$new(scouting_df)
```

```{r}
bscols(
  widths = c(3, 3, 6),
  filter_checkbox("league", "League", shared_players, ~Comp),
  filter_checkbox("pos", "Primary Position", shared_players, ~Position),
  list(
    filter_select("club", "Filter by Club (Optional)", shared_players, ~Squad),
    filter_slider("age", "Age Range", shared_players, ~Age, step = 1, width = "100%"),
    filter_slider("min", "Minutes Played", shared_players, ~Min, step = 90, width = "100%")
  )
)
```

### Interactive Scouting Map: Chance Creation vs. Defensive Work Rate

Hover over any dot to inspect a player, drag a box on the chart to highlight a group of players in the table below, or double-click to reset your selection.

```{r}
p_scout <- plot_ly(
  shared_players,
  x = ~`Tkl+Int`,
  y = ~SCA,
  color = ~Position,
  colors = "Dark2",
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  text = ~hover_text,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.72),
  height = 440
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Tackles + Interceptions per 90 Minutes (Defensive Work Rate)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Shot-Creating Actions per 90 Minutes (Attacking Creation)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.18)
  ) |>
  highlight(on = "plotly_selected", off = "plotly_deselect")

p_scout
```

### Searchable & Sortable Player Database

Click any column header to sort (hold `Shift` to sort by multiple columns), or use the search box on the right to look up any player or club directly.

```{r}
datatable(
  shared_players,
  rownames = FALSE,
  extensions = "Scroller",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(visible = FALSE, targets = 14) # Hide hover_text helper column
    )
  ),
  colnames = c(
    "Player",
    "Club",
    "League",
    "Position",
    "Age",
    "Minutes",
    "Goals",
    "Assists",
    "G+A",
    "G+A/90",
    "SCA/90",
    "Prog Pass/90",
    "Prog Carry/90",
    "Tkl+Int/90",
    "hover_text"
  )
)
```
